key_insight: RXNGraphormer is not only reproducible in independent testing, but also transfers well to external reaction prediction benchmarks. However, its performance drops in heterogeneous or distribution-shifted settings, highlighting where robustness still needs improvement.
problem_solved: This paper addresses the question of whether RXNGraphormer can be independently reproduced and whether its reported gains hold on external datasets beyond the original benchmark conditions.
method: Independent reproduction of RXNGraphormer results using the reported experimental setup.
Evaluation on external benchmark datasets for multiple reaction prediction tasks.
Comparison of performance under standard conditions versus heterogeneous and distribution-shifted settings to assess robustness and transferability.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this provides evidence that RXNGraphormer is a credible and reusable model for reaction prediction. It also offers a practical warning that strong benchmark performance may not fully carry over to real-world, shifted data.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing reproduction setup and external benchmark evaluation.
Side-by-side bar chart comparing original, reproduced, and external-dataset performance.
Shift/robustness heatmap illustrating performance changes under heterogeneous data.
Icon set for reproducibility, transferability, and distribution shift.
paper_title: Reusability report: Assessment of reproducibility and applicability to external datasets for RXNGraphormer
paper_authors: Chonghuan Zhang, Majian Zeng, Qianghua Lin, Kuangbiao Liao
